rows.ARS:
Medium pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MEIvildo
Exhibition name: Yves Piaget ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Marie-Louise (Louisette) Meilland (Paolino) (1920-1987) (France, 1975).
Introduced in France by Meilland et Cie in 1983 as 'Yves Piaget'.
Introduced in Australia by Ross Roses in 1986 as 'Queen Adelaide'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Strong fragrance. 80 petals. Average diameter 5". Large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, cupped, globular bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, upright. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 31" to 42" (80 to 105cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
